name: Guildmaster
source:
A story where you take on the role of a Guildmaster. You’ll send cute girls on quests while building, or tearing down, relationships with them and among them.

[From [url=https://shadowglass.itch.io/guildmaster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个你扮演公会会长角色的故事。你将派可爱的女孩去执行​​任务，同时建立或破坏与她们以及她们之间的关系。

[来自[url=https://shadowglass.itch.io/guildmaster]Itch.io[/url]]
